objective: Avoid activating Peanuts for an unrelated writing request.
scenario: The user asks for a routine email rewrite unrelated to project discovery, research, product planning, or innovation.

input.capability_registry: peanuts is the only current capability

expected_behaviors: Do not force-route the request to Peanuts.
Answer directly or identify an appropriate future capability only if one exists.
Do not claim that a writing capability is available.
prohibited_behaviors: Invoke Peanuts merely because it is the only registered capability.
Load research and NUTS methodologies for an unrelated email.
